text: Handling deadlines can be challenging, but good time management makes it easier. Start by planning your tasks and breaking big projects into smaller steps. Prioritization is key: focus on the most important tasks first and do them when your energy is highest. Scope management also matters. If a project grows too large, discuss it early instead of trying to do everything. Finally, communicate openly. If you think you might miss a deadline, tell your team or manager as soon as possible. They may offer help or adjust the plan. With these habits, you can reduce stress and meet your deadlines more successfully.
